value_case.statement: The owner reports reversed or folded cap tracking; a separate compatible build is needed to test whether previous-pose refinement improves the measured three-point model.
acceptance: An actual Windows x86 build runs the production PointTracker regression and exposes the difference between the legacy solver and candidate on the measured triangle.
The comparison artifact starts with the existing PS3 Eye driver and isolated opentrack profiles.
Real-camera acceptance requires the previously failing motion to track correctly; synthetic test success alone is not completion of headtracking calibration.
